inspiration.observed_pattern: The COLLATION scalar function reports the collation metadata of selected character columns.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one row with one general-collation label and one binary-collation code so both reported metadata names remain observable.

fixture_notes: The label and machine code use distinct explicit utf8mb4 collations, which COLLATION must report.
determinism_notes: Column declarations, row ID, collation names, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE label_catalog (label_id INT PRIMARY KEY, display_label VARCHAR(32) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL, machine_code VARCHAR(16) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT label_id, COLLATION(display_label) AS display_collation, COLLATION(machine_code) AS code_collation FROM label_catalog ORDER BY label_id
